nodes.description: GaintDex.admin: privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor and mutable via changeAdmin
GaintDex.feeAccount: address receiving collected fees, set to msg.sender in constructor
GaintDex.feeMake: maker fee in wei-per-ether units, default 700000000000000
GaintDex.feeTake: taker fee in wei-per-ether units, default 700000000000000
GaintDex.tokens: token address => user => balance ledger (token 0 = Ether); credited/debited across deposit, withdraw, depositToken, withdrawToken and tradeBalances
GaintDex.orders: user => order hash => bool mapping declared as public but never read or written by the implementation (dead state)
GaintDex.orderFills: user => order hash => filled amount; read and updated in trade, availableVolume and amountFilled
GaintDex constructor: sets admin/feeAccount to msg.sender and initializes feeMake/feeTake
changeAdmin(address): admin-only setter guarded by require(msg.sender == admin)
changeFeeAccount(address): admin-only setter for the fee receiving account
changeFeeMake(uint): admin-only setter for the maker fee
changeFeeTake(uint): admin-only setter for the taker fee
deposit() payable: credits tokens[0][msg.sender] with msg.value using safeAdd
withdraw(uint amount): debits Ether balance then performs a raw external call msg.sender.call.value(amount)() and ignores its return value
depositToken(address token,uint amount): calls TransferFrom on a caller supplied token contract before crediting the internal balance ledger
withdrawToken(address token,uint amount): debits the ledger then calls transfer on a caller supplied token contract
balanceOf(address token,address user) constant: read-only view over tokens mapping
trade(...): verifies an off-chain ECDSA signature with ecrecover, checks block.number <= expires and fill limit, then settles balances and records the fill
tradeBalances(...) private: computes maker/taker fees with safeMul and mutates the tokens ledger for both parties and feeAccount
testTrade(...) constant: dry-run checking user balance and availableVolume
availableVolume(...) constant: signature and expiry validation returning the tradeable amount
amountFilled(...) constant: returns orderFills[user][hash]
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint): multiplication with post-condition overflow assertion
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint): subtraction with assert(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint): addition with post-condition overflow assertion
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for authorization, balance ownership and as the target of raw value transfers
Unsafe low-level external call msg.sender.call.value(amount)() in withdraw, forwarding all gas with unchecked return
External call Token(token).transferFrom(msg.sender,this,amount) on a user supplied token address executed before internal accounting
External call Token(token).transfer(msg.sender,amount) on a user supplied token address
ecrecover over keccak256 hashes used as the only authorization for trade and availableVolume (signature/expiry validity)
block.number <= expires validity window in trade/availableVolume (miner influenced timestamp dependency)
Unchecked integer division /(1 ether) and safeMul(amountGive,amount)/amountGet in tradeBalances, denominator derived from user supplied amountGet
Unchecked division safeMul(tokens[tokenGive][user],amountGet)/amountGive in availableVolume, denominator is caller supplied
